notes: Use-district zoning sheet 10 (Dec. 1995). One heavy frame rule (~9 px) on left, top and right; the bottom edge sits just above the thick bar (~24 px) that rules off the full-width legend and title strip (rule 3; north arrow, scale bar and sheet number are in the strip, outside, so no remove polygon). No arcs, no other notches, no SECTION badge. BAY VIEW PARK, CANDLESTICK PARK, CANAL and the district codes are map; the map lines that end near the bottom bar (e.g. at x ~1400-2700) stop short of it. The top-left corner was moved 1 px in off a nub on the rule. No ink under the outline. Each side's inner edge was measured every 5 px along the side (the dark run of the rule in a 3-px band, runs wider than the rule's median width replaced by outer edge + median width), smoothed with a +-60 px running median, and the outline set ~2.5 px inside it (README rule 1), points every ~200 px; corners where straight fits of the last 300 px of the two sides meet. Every vertex checked on full-resolution close-ups.
